narratives.Description: Package runner exact-argv test spy fabricates an absent Windows option on POSIX
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5539 Prefer-A 6150303623)

1. Edit only the exact-argv calls.push recorder in tasks/engine-pm-run.test.cjs so windowsVerbatimArguments is captured only when Object.hasOwn.
2. file_scope: tasks/engine-pm-run.test.cjs (recorder-only).
3. Keep expected argv/assertions/wrapper/win32 assertion unchanged; preserve explicitly present undefined.
4. Keep-outs: no production executeAllowlisted change; no POSIX expected rewrite; no #3629 absorb.
